mapper.select: SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CLASS WHERE OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND APPROVAL_STATUS = '승인' AND STATUS = '모집중' ) AS RECRUITING_CLASS_COUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CLASS WHERE OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND APPROVAL_STATUS = '승인' ) AS TOTAL_CLASS_COUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INQUIRY WHERE OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND WRITER_TYPE = '작가' AND ANSWER IS NULL ) AS UNANSWERED_INQUIRY_COUNT, ( SELECT NVL(ROUND(AVG(ANSWER_DATE - INQUIRY_DATE), 1), 0) FROM INQUIRY WHERE OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND WRITER_TYPE = '작가' AND ANSWER_DATE IS NOT NULL ) AS AVERAGE_RESPONSE_DAYS, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(rv.PEOPLE_NUMBER), 0) FROM RESERVATION rv JOIN CLASS c ON rv.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND rv.STATUS = '예약' AND TRUNC(rv.RESERVATION_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) ) AS TODAY_RESERVATION_COUNT, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(rv.PEOPLE_NUMBER), 0) FROM RESERVATION rv JOIN CLASS c ON rv.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND rv.STATUS = '예약' AND TRUNC(rv.RESERVATION_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 1 ) AS YESTERDAY_RESERVATION_COUNT, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(p.AMOUNT), 0) FROM PAYMENT p JOIN RESERVATION rv ON p.RESERVATION_CODE = rv.RESERVATION_CODE JOIN CLASS c ON rv.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND p.STATUS = '결제완료' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CALCULATE ca WHERE ca.PAYMENT_CODE = p.PAYMENT_CODE ) ) AS AVAILABLE_SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PAYMENT p JOIN RESERVATION rv ON p.RESERVATION_CODE = rv.RESERVATION_CODE JOIN CLASS c ON rv.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND p.STATUS = '결제완료' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CALCULATE ca WHERE ca.PAYMENT_CODE = p.PAYMENT_CODE ) ) AS AVAILABLE_SETTLEMENT_COUNT FROM DUAL

SELECT s.SCHEDULE_CODE, c.CLASS_CODE, c.NAME AS CLASS_TITLE, ( SELECT MIN(ci.IMAGE) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY ci.SORT_ORDER) FROM CLASS_IMG ci WHERE ci.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE AND ci.TYPE = '대표' ) AS THUMBNAIL_PATH, s.START_TIME, s.END_TIME, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(rv.PEOPLE_NUMBER), 0) FROM RESERVATION rv WHERE rv.SCHEDULE_CODE = s.SCHEDULE_CODE AND rv.STATUS = '예약' ) AS RESERVED_COUNT, s.MAX_PEOPLE AS CAPACITY, CASE WHEN s.SOLD_OUT_YN = 'Y' THEN '모집 마감' ELSE '진행 예정' END AS SCHEDULE_STATUS, cr.ACTIVITY_NAME AS AUTHOR_NAME FROM SCHEDULE s JOIN CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r ON s.REPEAT_RULE_CODE = r.REPEAT_RULE_CODE JOIN CLASS c ON r.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE JOIN CREATOR cr ON c.OPERATOR_CODE = cr.OPERATOR_CODE WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND c.APPROVAL_STATUS = '승인' AND c.STATUS IN ('모집중', '준비중') AND TRUNC(s.CLASS_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) ORDER BY s.START_TIME, s.SCHEDULE_CODE

SELECT ALERT_TYPE, ALERT_TITLE, ALERT_CONTENT, ALERT_COUNT, TARGET_URL FROM ( SELECT 'REVIEW' AS ALERT_TYPE, '답글 미작성 리뷰' AS ALERT_TITLE, '고객 리뷰에 답글을 남겨주세요.' AS ALERT_CONTENT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW r JOIN CLASS c ON r.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND r.REPLY_CONTENT IS NULL ) AS ALERT_COUNT, '/author/reviews' AS TARGET_URL FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'INQUIRY', '1:1 문의 답변 대기', '관리자 답변을 기다리는 문의가 있습니다.', ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INQUIRY WHERE OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND WRITER_TYPE = '작가' AND ANSWER IS NULL ), '/author/qna' FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'SETTLEMENT', '정산 신청 가능', '정산 가능한 매출이 쌓였습니다.', ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PAYMENT p JOIN RESERVATION rv ON p.RESERVATION_CODE = rv.RESERVATION_CODE JOIN CLASS c ON rv.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND p.STATUS = '결제완료' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CALCULATE ca WHERE ca.PAYMENT_CODE = p.PAYMENT_CODE ) ), '/author/settlements/new' FROM DUAL ) WHERE ALERT_COUNT > 0

SELECT d.RESERVATION_DATE, NVL(rv.RESERVATION_COUNT, 0) AS RESERVATION_COUNT FROM ( SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE) - (7 - LEVEL) AS RESERVATION_DATE FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 7 ) d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TRUNC(rv.RESERVATION_DATE) AS RESERVATION_DATE, COUNT(*) AS RESERVATION_COUNT FROM RESERVATION rv JOIN CLASS c ON rv.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND rv.STATUS = '예약' AND rv.RESERVATION_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 6 GROUP BY TRUNC(rv.RESERVATION_DATE) ) rv ON d.RESERVATION_DATE = rv.RESERVATION_DATE ORDER BY d.RESERVATION_DATE

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT rv.RESERVATION_CODE, c.CLASS_CODE, c.NAME AS CLASS_TITLE, ct.NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME, m.NAME AS MEMBER_NAME, rv.PEOPLE_NUMBER, rv.RESERVATION_DATE, rv.STATUS AS RESERVATION_STATUS FROM RESERVATION rv JOIN CLASS c ON c.CLASS_CODE = rv.CLASS_CODE JOIN CATEGORY ct ON ct.CATEGORY_CODE = c.CATEGORY_CODE JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_CODE = rv.MEMBER_CODE WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} ORDER BY rv.RESERVATION_DATE DESC, rv.RESERVATION_CODE DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 7
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT NOTICE_CODE, NOTICE_TYPE, TITLE, INPUT_DATE FROM NOTICE ORDER BY INPUT_DATE DESC, NOTICE_CODE DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3

SELECT cr.OPERATOR_CODE AS AUTHOR_CODE, cr.ACTIVITY_NAME AS AUTHOR_NAME, cr.PROFILE_IMAGE AS PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, cr.CREATOR_INTRODUCTION AS AUTHOR_INTRODUCTION, cr.ACTIVITY_REGION, cr.APPROVAL_STATUS, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CLASS c WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = cr.OPERATOR_CODE ) AS CLASS_COUNT, NVL(( SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.STAR_RATING), 1) FROM REVIEW r JOIN CLASS c ON r.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = cr.OPERATOR_CODE ), 0) AS AVERAGE_RATING, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW r JOIN CLASS c ON r.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = cr.OPERATOR_CODE ) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM CREATOR cr WHERE cr.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode}
